product.name: The Harshal Priyavadan Patel Financial Model
product.model_class: provider-attributed market-context calculations and display-only visualization

dashboard.view: One Financial Model view containing Market Charts and Orb 2 side by side.
dashboard.combination_type: presentation only; calculations and data paths remain independent
must_not_join_or_mutate: Market Charts selected ticker into Orb 2 observations
Market Charts selected provider into Orb 2 provider routing
Market Charts 1h/1d interval into Orb 2 timeframe
Orb 2 timeframe into Market Charts interval
missing inputs into zero or neutral values

manual_tradingview_reference.role: historical design inspiration; not proof of source-runtime parity

domain_and_build_history.owner_reported_transition: Moving from Inspiration Script 1's Regular approach to the Logarithmic financial model required a ground-up build incorporating per-ticker granularity.
domain_and_build_history.granularity: Evaluate each ticker's own supplied series independently; do not pool raw price levels across tickers.
domain_and_build_history.logarithmic_scope: Core price-band construction and per-ticker band displacement use natural-log price space; not every sub-indicator is wholly logarithmic.
domain_and_build_history.caveat: The v4 source is not archived here; Regular/Logarithmic labels and build history are project-owner-reported, not independently source-diff verified.

automatic_provider_observations.retrieval_method: automatic provider APIs through configured routes
automatic_provider_observations.role: provider-reported market observations for runtime calculations and development/review context

source_provenance.separation_note: The Pine v4 inspiration set is distinct from the separately archived user-supplied Pine v6 transcriptions under scripts/pine/.

source_modes.label: Synthetic demo
source_modes.selection_rule: explicit user choice; never silently substitute for live data

orb2.data_path: same-origin Worker field read; provider collection and credentials remain server-side

normalization: Take at most the final 5000 input rows before normalization.
Reject a row without a finite parseable timestamp or finite close.
If any of open/high/low is present, require all three.
Reject non-finite or non-positive OHLC/close and inconsistent ranges; high must cover open and close, low must cover open and close, and high must not be below low.
If volume is present, require a finite non-negative value; preserve missing volume as missing.
Set confirmed true only when the input value is exactly true.
For duplicate timestamps, the last input row wins; sort ascending and retain at most 5000 bars.
chart_packet_contract.default_price_source_fallback: HLC3, HL2, open, high, or low falls back to close when the needed range/value is absent; absent fields remain absent.
chart_packet_contract.no_data_policy: No valid bars produces no-data; do not fabricate bars, prices, or volume.

market_chart_algorithms.rolling_standard_deviation: population standard deviation: sqrt(sum((x - window_mean)^2) / window_length)
market_chart_algorithms.ema: alpha = 2/(length+1); initialize at first finite input; next = alpha*current + (1-alpha)*previous

vfi.availability: All bars must contain finite open, high, low, and volume; otherwise VFI and signal are null/unavailable.
equations: A_(i-1) = 130-bar SMA(volume) ending on the previous bar
Q_i = +Vcap_i if T_i-T_(i-1) > K_i; -Vcap_i if T_i-T_(i-1) < -K_i; otherwise 0
default VFI = rawVFI; optional smoothing is disabled by default
vfi.warmup: All rolling inputs and all flow contributions in the VFI window must be available; retain null until then.

log_fibonacci_bands.basis_default: 200-bar VWMA of x_i; if volume is unavailable or VWMA volume sum is zero, use the 200-bar SMA of x_i
log_fibonacci_bands.dispersion: 3 times the 200-bar population standard deviation of x_i around its ordinary rolling mean
log_fibonacci_bands.price_boundary: Exponentiate only after center and offsets are calculated in natural-log space.
log_fibonacci_bands.ticker_granularity: Calculate the log-price bands per ticker from that ticker's own series; do not pool raw price levels across tickers.

equations: CI = (source - ESA)/(0.015*D), or 0 when D is 0
wavetrend.higher_timeframe: Disabled by default; when enabled, map only confirmed higher-timeframe values to base bars.

divergence.regular_bullish: Price lower pivot low, WT1 higher pivot low, and prior WT1 pivot below -53.
divergence.regular_bearish: Price higher pivot high, WT1 lower pivot high, and prior WT1 pivot above 53.
divergence.confirmation_delay: A pivot is detected after the right-side lookback bars exist.

signal_gates: Default confirmClose=true: current-bar conditions require latest bar confirmed.
Crosses require finite current and preceding values.
Price band signals require current and previous bands.
VFI signals additionally require current and previous VFI and signal values.
Alerts are descriptive UI annotations only; no order or recommendation is produced.

available_features.wave: If WT1 and WT2 finite: Clamp(tanh((WT1-WT2)/45), -1, 1).

metric.score: Arithmetic mean of available features, clamped to [-1,1]; null if no feature exists.
metric.quality: available_feature_count / 4; feature coverage only, not statistical confidence.

freshness.window_applies_to: intraday bar timestamp; simplified fixed UTC rule, not an exchange calendar

equations: alignment = +1 for same nonzero signs; -1 for opposite nonzero signs; 0 if either is zero

statuses.hold: daily baseline unavailable; do not use intraday-only force
statuses.baseline-only: daily available; intraday missing, unavailable, or stale
statuses.composed: daily and positive-freshness intraday metrics available

composition.volatility_scale: intraday log band width * sqrt(26) for a daily-equivalent display context; not a forecast

orb2_geometry.band_radius: 2.12 * 1.45^(bandIndex + fraction), based on log_1.45(max(1, abs(displacement))); held band uses 2.12

axes.bandAxis: clamp(2*(p-0.5), -1, 1); compositionPosition replaces p when available; priceAxis is layout fallback if band held

extension.reported_value: maximum available extension; unavailable if both inputs are missing
extension.extra_radial_push: 0.45*waveExtension when valid band frame exists; basis distance is already included in band radius and is not added a second time

orb2_geometry.missing_market_packet: held placeholder; never fabricate location or interpret missing as calm
orb2_geometry.meaning: deterministic display geometry only; no value, rank, target, probability, or recommendation

dollar_strength_reference.status: display-only daily reference; not licensed real-time ICE-distributed DXY/USDX
dollar_strength_reference.requires: six confirmed, positive, finite, non-synthetic closes, fresh within four days, not over five minutes in the future, with identical bar timestamps

provenance_and_failure_invariants: Keep provider/source, symbol, interval, timestamp, confirmation, synthetic flag, and status attached to each displayed observation where supplied.
Never convert missing, invalid, stale, refused, or unconfirmed input into zero, neutral, calm, or a live synthetic substitute.
Market Charts has explicit user-selectable synthetic demo; do not label it live.
Chart freshness must be judged from provider timestamps/status; there is no universal chart-side age cutoff.
Orb 2 missing daily baseline returns hold; missing/stale intraday returns baseline-only.
Never call the DS reference the official licensed live ICE DXY value.
No chart label, signal, score, color, animation, or spatial coordinate issues a recommendation or executes an order.
